fixes.explanation: Ooh, I think the simple sound of it tricked you, baker. It's true, and Moses says it plain: “Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and carefully follow these statutes.” (Deuteronomy 16:12) Remembering and following the statutes come in the very same verse. I spent years stuck in the back of a junk drawer before an angel called me out, and I can tell you, remembering that makes the good days taste sweeter. I think Israel might feel the same.

problems.problem: Saying Moses is not asking them to remember the hard part just to feel it adds a claim about his purpose that the text does not give.
Papa refers to being forgotten in a dark place without identifying the junk drawer, leaving a baker unfamiliar with his backstory without the context.
